agents.name: PROJECT CO-ORDINATOR
agents.does: Keeps every project moving in real time: live milestone tracking, handoff alerts, blockers, and status updates before a deadline slips.
agents.brief: Monitor active project timelines every hour, flag blockages in the same workday, and push owners to clear dependencies before they affect delivery. Keep the owner updated with a live status snapshot during any risk event.

agents.name: INBOUND LEADS MANAGER
agents.does: Qualifies every inbound lead in real time, routes hot opportunities to the right rep immediately, and follows up before momentum fades.
agents.brief: Respond within 15 minutes for high-intent inquiries. Mark lead quality, route by fit, and send a follow-up note the same hour. Escalate anything that needs the owner or a sales call.
